summary: Only publicly listed shelters may be surfaced: the CLI must fetch the complete Red Cross hidden set, fail closed if it cannot be verified, and drop matches from every source by name or address identity.
reason: The two feeds disagree about visibility. The Red Cross withholds operational-only and not-cleared-for-walk-in sites from its public map, but FEMA's OpenShelters mirror can still carry them, so a union of the two feeds can re-publish a location its operator deliberately hid. Visibility verification is mandatory in every data-source mode, side feeds must not truncate silently, and ambiguous occupancy identities must never receive a population.
validated_outcome: Tests verify mandatory fail-closed suppression, address plus ZIP identity, dry-run network avoidance, complete two-page ArcGIS fetching, and withholding of ambiguous occupancy rows.
